**Changes**
- Cloud models, if you want them: a new Providers page adds OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, or any server with the same API (LM Studio, Ollama). Pick a provider, paste its key, then choose models from its own list, with search. Chosen models appear in the Speech and Cleanup choices with a cloud icon. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you pick one.
- API keys are kept in the system credential store (Windows Credential Manager, the macOS Keychain, the Secret Service on Linux), never in config.toml. They go only to the provider's saved address, only over https (plain http to this computer alone), never along a redirect, and are blanked out of any error before it is logged. The settings window shows the last four characters; Show reveals the key for 30 seconds.
- A slot filled by a cloud model loads no local model, so graphics memory stays free. If the cloud fails, the local model cleans that dictation instead and a notification says why.
- On OpenRouter, thinking is switched off for cleanup: about 2-3 seconds per dictation instead of 9-31 with a reasoning model.
- Settings save themselves as you change them. There is no Save button any more, and the page no longer jumps after a change.
- The "cloud or Claude" check is told your vocabulary, so it recognises the words you actually use: of 17 test sentences that meant the term, Gemma now gets 16 (was 12) and S1-mini 8 (was 3).
- The old external transcription endpoint becomes a provider on first start, and its key moves to the credential store.

**Fixes**
- Deleting a vocabulary set, restoring shipped words and removing a provider now ask first.
- A notification Windows refuses to show is written to the log with the reason.
